title: Google dev-docs voice prompt to strip LLM slop from technical prose
summary: Aaron Villalpando shares a one-line style constraint—Google developer-docs dead prose, no aphorisms—that rewrites marketing-flourish docs into plain functional section titles and scope statements, shown on a BAML Studio diff.
question_it_answers: What short prompt forces agent-written docs into Google developer-docs plain prose?

claims.text: Author claims slop writing is mostly solved by asking for Google dev docs style dead prose.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: Exact constraint: make it like google dev docs style with more dead prose and no aphorisms or flourishes.
claims.evidence: Can you make it like google dev docs style. More dead prose. No aphorisms, no flourishes. Simple.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

media.description: Side-by-side doc diff: marketing headings like Start here count everything become plain Start here and Two layers of records in Google dev-docs tone.
